subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should OpenClaw add opt-in silent STT history enrichment for unmentioned audio in requireMention Discord channels, and should the contract be Discord-only or shared across channels?
rationale: The missing source behavior is clear, but retaining unmentioned speech changes privacy/security expectations and adds configuration surface that OpenClaw policy treats as maintainer-owned product direction.

options.title: Shared opt-in channel contract
options.body: Define a generic channel-history enrichment contract and implement Discord first with security, provenance, failure, and no-reply tests.

options.title: Discord-only option
options.body: Add a narrow Discord guild/channel setting now, accepting later migration risk if Signal, WhatsApp, Telegram, or other channels need the same policy.

options.title: Decline silent retention
options.body: Keep mention-gated Discord behavior as-is and document that unmentioned audio is not transcribed into later history.

recommendation.title: Shared opt-in channel contract
recommendation.body: Define a generic channel-history enrichment contract and implement Discord first with security, provenance, failure, and no-reply tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent current-main work owns the exact Discord preflight/history/config files where the decision would land first.
